$source: Extracted from the EyeQ prototype (DS · Colour tokens, DS · Type/spacing/radii/elevation/icons, DS · Motion moments, DS · Components). The prototype is the authority; if a value here disagrees with a screen, the screen wins and this file gets fixed.

usage.violet: Structure: primary buttons, selected tabs, progress fills, links, level badges. Never for alerts.
usage.red: The one action: at most one red button per screen (Start session, Mark done, Buy). Red text only for destructive or loss states.
usage.emberAndGold: Rewards only: streak flame is ember; XP and coins are gold. The only warm colours.
usage.surfaces: Flat fills with 1 px hairlines. No blur, no glass, no photo backgrounds.
usage.status: Never colour alone: always paired with a glyph or a label.

display.use: Numbers, levels, headlines only. Never paragraphs.

font.numerals: tabular-nums everywhere a number can change

type.rules: Minimum body 15 px; captions 13 px, never below 12. Sizes in rem so 200 % OS scaling reflows. Text rows use min-height, not fixed height.

elevation.rule: Elevation is a lighter surface plus a brighter hairline, not blur. One real shadow level.

icon.rule: Outline set; filled variants only for the active tab and the streak flame. Reward glyphs carry their semantic colour; the rest inherit text colour. SVG paths are in screens/01_DS_Type_spacing_radii_elevation_icons.html.

xpCountUp.note: Number ticks 0 to total in 700 ms (easeOutQuart, whole numbers); bar fills old to new over 900 ms; breakdown lines stamp in 80 ms apart. Haptic: light at 700 ms.

streakFlame.note: Flame springs 60 % to 115 % to 100 %; ember glow blooms to 18 %; count slides up 250 ms later. Flame size tier: 1-6 small, 7-20 medium, 21+ large. Haptic: medium at 480 ms.

levelUp.note: Full-screen on primary-subtle ground; hex badge springs from 30 % with a -12 degree twist; rays burst and fade; title slides up. Haptic: success at 500 ms.

badgeUnlock.note: Tile flips in on Y from 90 degrees with 4 % overshoot; one diagonal sheen at 500 ms. Several badges stagger 120 ms, max three on screen, rest collapse into '+N more'. Haptic: light at 550 ms.

rankChange.note: Own row swaps with the overtaken row, 48 px translate with 4 px overshoot; delta stamps in after. Digits cross-fade, never spin. No haptic.

rules: Every moment is under 1.2 s and never blocks the next action: Continue is live from frame 0.
Two curves only: spring for things that gain, settle for things that move.
Vector shapes, strokes and opacity only. No blur, particles, GIF, or Lottie heavier than 60 KB.
Tap anywhere to skip. Reduced motion collapses everything to a cross-fade. Sound off by default.
Never for failure: streak-lost and paywall states get a 200 ms fade only.

component: Button: cta (red), primary (violet), ghost, disabled-with-reason, icon 44, small 40, text link
Chip: default, selected, measurement area (violet + eye glyph), coin, XP
XP bar: 10 px track, violet fill, ticks at 25 %
Streak counter: done, pending, at risk (amber chip + countdown), frozen (sky), lost (muted, best streak shown)
Rank row: 56 px min, display-face numeral, initials avatar, sport and level, weekly XP; own row violet-subtle and pinned when off-screen
Drill card: pending, done (struck, green), locked (dashed border, lock glyph, how to unlock)
Challenge card: progress bar + fraction; paid adds price chip and prize line
Video player frame: 16:9, violet progress, red play, set chip, CC on
Paywall plan card: radio semantics; selected = violet-subtle fill + 2 px violet border
Bottom tab bar: Home, Train, Compete, Progress, Profile; active = violet label + 3 px bar; labels always shown
Toast: bottom, 3 s, one line, optional Undo
Modal / bottom sheet: sheets for decisions, centred modals only for blocking errors; two buttons max
Empty (glyph + one line + next action), loading (shimmer skeleton matching row shape, never spinners in lists), locked
Inputs: phone with +91 prefix, 6-digit OTP boxes, segmented control, toggle with an On/Off word
